forum.title: Which is the STEVAL-MKI183V1's MEMS Sensor, LPS33HW or LPS28DFW?
forum.best_answer_content:
Mouser has an LPS33HW datasheet:

<https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/389/lps33hw-1156299.pdf?srsltid=AfmBOoq5cFa4IK0YvtpXUmxkieXXw8UMgl5vsNlzsbMLEDjnfyVY8NvE>

ST have a video on their YouTube channel:

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t0o_VYNuWf0>

The link in that video goes to:

<https://www.st.com/content/st_com/en/products/mems-and-sensors/pressure-sensors/lps33hw.html>

but that just gives a ‘page not found’ error.

Looks like this product must have been discontinued ?
forum.content_text:
In the STEVAL-MKI183V1’s [data brief sheet](https://www.st.com/resource/en/data_brief/steval-mki183v1.pdf) it’s saying that it uses LPS33HW product family barometer sensors. But when you click on the linked web site of the LPS33HW product it takes you to [LPS28DFW’s ST web site](https://www.st.com/en/mems-and-sensors/lps28dfw.html?ecmp=tt7628_us_social_jul2018). So is the board got update and it now uses LPS28DFW or is it a mistake? If it’s a mistake; where is the LPS33HW’s web site? Because i can’t find it on web. There is no website for LPS33HW on ST that i can find datasheet of it.

If there is someone knows that answer please let me know.
forum.author: KeremEfeS

scraped_replies.html:
Welcome ​@KeremEfeS, to the community!

Sorry for the confusion, but the solution to the riddle is relatively simple:

  • the LPS33W has been obsolete and unavailable for quite some time
  • for the STEVAL-MKI183V1, NRND (Not Recommended for New Designs) is therefore already noted on its product website, which is why it should only be used for projects already in progress
  • the data brief for the STEVAL-MKI183V1 was last updated in 2019, so it still contains the link to the LPS33W; however, this link is redirected by the ST website to the possible replacement, the LPS28DFW

I hope I have cleared up the confusion a little?

Regards
/Peter
scraped_replies.author: Peter BENSCH

scraped_replies.html:
Thanks for the welcome ​@Peter BENSCH;

Yes you cleared the confusion but I still need the datasheet of that sensor. Because I’m not looking for buying a new sensor, I already have the MKI183V1 in my hand and I need to use it. 

The sensor can be discontinued but why would ST delete the sensor’s all data? I think there is datasheet in somewhere that we can’t reach. 

Anyways, thanks for the answer.
